transcription: I thought someone was secretly living in my apartment. The truth was even worse. About a month ago, weird stuff started happening in my apartment. I live alone, and I'm super tidy borderline obsessive. But I kept noticing small changes a mug left out that I know I put away. My toothpaste slightly squeezed from the middle. A chair moved a few inches out of place. It was never big. Just enough to make me second-guess myself. I even started taking pictures before leaving home to prove to myself I wasn't going crazy. One night, I heard a noise, like someone shuffling papers. I was in bed, lights off, door locked. My heart just stopped. I quietly got up, grabbed a kitchen knife, and opened my bedroom door. Nothing. Silence. But I checked the hallway camera the next morning. Motion detected. No one in or out. I thought someone's already inside I was this close to calling the cops or sleeping in my car. But then I noticed something on the camera I hadn't seen before a pattern. The movement always happened right after I left for work. And then it hit me. I confronted my landlord. Turns out he'd been using his emergency key to come in when I was gone, not to steal, not to live there. But to use my bidet. His own apartment didn't have one, and he was too embarrassed to buy one. I stared at him in disbelief as he said I always cleaned up after myself. Didn't think you'd notice. I moved out three days later.
